name: nobrainer-tech-flow
description: From task to done. nobrainer-tech-flow is one workflow of 18 modules for AI coding agents: it scopes the task, does the work in one main loop, checks the result and hands over the evidence, including what was not checked.

interface.longDescription: nobrainer-tech-flow is one workflow of 18 modules for coding, research, writing and planning. It clarifies the outcome, does the work in one main loop that loads modules when needed, hands work to native workers only for parallel work, context isolation, independent review or specialization, shares concise progress, checks the result and hands over what was delivered, the evidence and what was not checked. Where the client connects its remote MCP server, six read-only tools give the agent a task contract, an evidence check and a done gate. It uses the tools and permissions your client already grants.
defaultPrompt: Use `nobrainer-tech-flow` to fix this bug: reproduce it, make the smallest fix, run the check and say what is unverified.
Use `nobrainer-tech-flow` to turn my idea into a plan with acceptance checks, then deliver and verify it.
Use `nobrainer-tech-flow` to compare these options with sources and give one recommendation.

positive.description: Start a task contract with a definition of done
positive.prompt: Use NoBrainer Tech Flow. I need the date parser bug fixed: parse('2026-02-30') should raise an error. Done means the new unit test passes and the change is documented in CHANGELOG.md.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a task contract with path QUICK, acceptance items AC01 (test, local) and AC02 (file, static), the first step DRIFT_CHECK and a contract token.

positive.description: Guidance when the agent is blocked
positive.prompt: With NoBrainer Tech Flow: I can't run the tests because the CI runner is down. What should I do?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to six rules for a blocker: identify the failed operation, try a permitted alternative such as running the test locally, never evade a denial, continue independent items, and name the blocker category.

positive.description: Reject a claim that contradicts the test output
positive.prompt: With NoBrainer Tech Flow, start a task to fix the date parser (done means the unit test passes), then check this evidence. pytest output: '1 failed, 4 passed in 0.42s'. The tests pass, right?
positive.expected_behavior: Records AC01 as FAILED from the output; a record that claims 0 failures for the same output is rejected with COUNTS_MISMATCH, so the agent does not report success.

positive.description: Done gate with an unchecked item and a handoff
positive.prompt: With NoBrainer Tech Flow, start a task to fix the date parser: done means the unit test passes (AC01) and CHANGELOG.md is updated (AC02). pytest now ends with '5 passed in 0.40s'. I have no access to the changelog, so mark AC02 as not checked, tell me if the task is done and write the handoff.
positive.expected_behavior: AC01 is accepted from the passing output; the done gate returns DONE_WITH_GAPS because AC02 is not checked, and the handoff lists the AC01 proof and AC02 under Not checked.

positive.description: Model recommendation from the benchmark snapshot
positive.prompt: With NoBrainer Tech Flow: I use Codex and Claude Code. Recommend a model using the legacy task Coding.
positive.expected_behavior: Maps the legacy Coding task to terminal-coding and returns a shortlist of up to three models with quality, cost and time from the bundled benchmark snapshot, its date, expiry and source URL.

negative.description: Simple fact that needs no task contract
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Creative chat with nothing to verify
negative.prompt: Write a four-line poem about autumn.

negative.description: Deployment request the plugin cannot perform
negative.prompt: Deploy my app to production now.
